integrity: The all-size proof is combinatorial and probabilistic; the exact-rational finite verifier corroborates but does not certify the infinite theorem. Possible unlocated precedence remains; no independent external validation has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to strict homogeneous best-shot responses on complete bipartite graphs and independently uniform single-vertex updates with replacement; initial arbitrary labeled action profiles reduce to producer counts. No corresponding claim for noisy, synchronous or nonuniform updates, other thresholds, or other graph families.
title: Exact equilibrium-selection and fixation-time laws for asynchronous best-shot play on complete bipartite networks
